            Field manual

            Read it before you need it.

            Survival tips

            • You carry four weapons: a primary, a secondary, a melee weapon and an explosive, on keys 1 to 4. Change them in the Loadout tab.
            • Melee hits whatever is in front of you within reach. Aim at the head for extra damage.
            • Weapon skins drop from crates. Earn crates by surviving deep runs, clean waves and hard contracts; open them in the Locker.
            • Crouch while sprinting to slide. Jump out of a slide to keep your speed.
            • Push forward into waist-high cover to vault it, or chest-high cover to climb on top.
            • A stim restores 250 health. You carry three and earn one back for each wave cleared.
            • The radar only shows raiders while they are firing, so watch for the red dots.
            • With the sniper scoped in, hold sprint to steady your aim.
            • For co-op or versus, invite friends to your squad, or everyone picks the mode and types the same squad code. The first player to deploy picks the map; everyone else presses Deploy to join them.

            Esc always pauses the game
            Trackpad stops while you press keys?

            That's Windows ignoring the trackpad while you type, and it affects any key: moving, crouching, reloading. The game never receives the movement, so the fix is in Windows:

            1. Open Settings › Bluetooth & devices › Touchpad.
            2. Open Taps and set Touchpad sensitivity to Most sensitive.
            3. No such option? Your laptop uses a Synaptics or ELAN driver. Open its touchpad app and turn off PalmCheck, Palm rejection or Disable touchpad while typing.
            Switches crouch and aim to tap-to-toggle and turns on auto-reload, so you hold keys less.
